name: Nemesis Trap
oracle_text:
If a white creature is attacking, you may pay {B}{B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Exile target attacking creature. Create a token that's a copy of that creature. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

name: Lethargy Trap
oracle_text:
If three or more creatures are attacking, you may pay {U} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Attacking creatures get -3/-0 until end of turn.

name: Arrow Volley Trap
oracle_text:
If four or more creatures are attacking, you may pay {1}{W} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Arrow Volley Trap deals 5 damage divided as you choose among any number of target attacking creatures.

name: Pitfall Trap
oracle_text:
If exactly one creature is attacking, you may pay {W} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Destroy target attacking creature without flying.

name: Slingbow Trap
oracle_text:
If a black creature with flying is attacking, you may pay {G} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Destroy target attacking creature with flying.

name: Whiplash Trap
oracle_text:
If an opponent had two or more creatures enter the battlefield under their control this turn, you may pay {U} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Return two target creatures to their owners' hands.

name: Permafrost Trap
oracle_text:
If an opponent had a green creature enter the battlefield under their control this turn, you may pay {U} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.

name: Baloth Cage Trap
oracle_text:
If an opponent had an artifact enter the battlefield under their control this turn, you may pay {1}{G} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Create a 4/4 green Beast creature token.

name: Lavaball Trap
oracle_text:
If an opponent had two or more lands enter the battlefield under their control this turn, you may pay {3}{R}{R} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Destroy two target lands. Lavaball Trap deals 4 damage to each creature.

Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)

name: Birds of Paradise
oracle_text:
